extension.summary: Personal TV shows and movies add-on with TorBox playback
extension.description: Browse TV shows and movies, choose a source yourself and play it through your own TorBox account. For personal use.
extension.news: 0.3.2: The Polish tab no longer lists English-only releases. 0.3.1: Sources have English and Polish tabs that never mix; multi-audio releases with both languages are in both. 0.3.0: Sources are sorted into quality tabs (4K, 1080p, 720p, SD, Other) with a choice of order; cinema recordings (CAM, TS) are hidden, spam and other-year releases are listed last and marked in red. Popular and Top rated lists can be filtered and sorted by genre, year, rating and release date. 0.2.1: Continue Watching and the title page show whether the next episode is available, not available, airs on a date, or has no English audio. 0.2.0: TV shows and movies from TMDB. Seasons, Continue Watching, My List and More like this. Plays English releases through TorBox; titles without an English release list their own-language releases and say so. 0.1.0: First NovaFlix build.
